proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING REPORT ON PLANT-BASED MILK PRICING
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report examining costs to Starbucks' reputation and projected sales from its upcharge on plant-based milk, presented to shareholders by end of third quarter.
proposals.evidence: The Starbucks board of directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING CEO SUCCESSION PLANNING POLICY AMENDMENT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending Corporate Governance Principles to expand CEO succession planning policy with position qualifications, internal candidate development, and three-year lead time requirements.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors adopted these changes on December 23, 2022.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING ANNUAL REPORT ON COMPANY OPERATIONS IN CHINA
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report to shareholders on the nature and extent to which corporate operations depend on and are vulnerable to China, excluding confidential business information.
proposals.evidence: The Starbucks board of directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING ASSESSMENT OF WORKER RIGHTS COMMITMENTS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests independent third-party assessment of Starbucks' adherence to freedom of association and collective bargaining commitments, publicly disclosed on its website.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that our shareholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING CREATION OF BOARD COMMITTEE ON CORPORATE SUSTAINABILITY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests creation of a board committee on corporate sustainability to oversee the impact of policy positions and advocacy, with a public report by end of 2023.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that our shareholders vote against this proposal.
